title.zh: 【ZKsync 推出证明器 Airbender Prime，面向后量子安全】
title.en: 【ZKsync 推出证明器 Airbender Prime，面向后量子安全】

current_state.zh: ZKsync launched the Airbender Prime prover, claiming the first single-GPU real-time proving of Ethereum mainnet blocks using a post-quantum, RISC-V-based hash STARK design that replaces BN254 pairings with Keccak-256 commitments.
current_state.en: ZKsync launched the Airbender Prime prover, claiming the first single-GPU real-time proving of Ethereum mainnet blocks using a post-quantum, RISC-V-based hash STARK design that replaces BN254 pairings with Keccak-256 commitments.
